item.title: Can Democrats Close the ‘God Gap’ in November?
item.itunes:title: Can Democrats Close the ‘God Gap’ in November?
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
After helping power President Donald Trump’s two presidential wins, some GOP analysts are concerned the party is not doing enough to turn out White evangelical voters. We look what might keep them home and examine how some Democrats are leaning on their own faith journeys to try and win some of them back. 

--- 

Guest: Lauren Fox, CNN Congressional Correspondent 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin

item.title: Can Lindsay Graham’s Sister Survive in South Carolina?
item.itunes:title: Can Lindsay Graham’s Sister Survive in South Carolina?
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
GOP operatives in South Carolina say the campaign of Sen. Darline Graham has been lackluster, fueling Democratic excitement in a Republican stronghold. Is it because she is a political newcomer thrust into the spotlight following the death of her brother, Sen. Linsday Graham, or something else? We sift through Sunday’s debate and look at why talk of a political dynasty is rubbing some Republican voters the wrong way. 

--- 

Guest: Dianne Gallagher, CNN Correspondent 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin

item.title: ‘Just Start Shooting’: Data Center Backlash Turns Violent
item.itunes:title: ‘Just Start Shooting’: Data Center Backlash Turns Violent
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
From polling to local Facebook groups, you can clearly see how concerned many Americans are about artificial intelligence data centers in both. But lately, law enforcement has been forced to investigate perceived calls for violence against local officials related to these projects. We examine the fine line between free speech and calls for violence.

Note: This episode contains strong language. 

--- 

Guest: Curt Devine, CNN Investigates Senior Producer 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin
